subject: Renewal: Incremental Dedicated GPUs & EU/APAC regional pools — onboarding plan
messages:
From: Marta Ruiz <marta.ruiz@atlaslabs.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@atlaslabs.com, Ethan Cho <ethan.cho@atlaslabs.com>
Date: Tue, 18 Aug 2026 08:42:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal planning — adding EU/APAC dedicated pools and throughput guarantees

Hannah,

As we discussed on the renewal call last week, Atlas Labs is preparing to expand our committed footprint for the next 12-month term. We want to add two regional Reserved GPU pools (one EU, one APAC) in addition to the existing US reserve. The ask: +24 A100-equivalent GPUs for EU, +16 A100-equivalent GPUs for APAC, and a firm per-region throughput baseline (tokens/sec) with a defined burst policy.

High-level priorities:
- Low tail latency for users in Frankfurt and Singapore (p99 < 300ms for short-chat workloads)
- Predictable monthly token throughput and a soft-burst allowance for spikes
- Clear failover path if a region is degraded

Can you confirm sequence for the amendment, expected timeline for provisioning, and any onboarding activities on our side? Procurement will also need a PO and an updated contract that shows the term change and pricing.

Thanks — Marta

--
Marta Ruiz
Head of Platform
Atlas Labs
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah@redwood.com>
To: Marta Ruiz <marta.ruiz@atlaslabs.com>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 19 Aug 2026 09:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal planning — adding EU/APAC dedicated pools and throughput guarantees

Marta —

Thanks for the clarity. We can support the two regional pools as an amendment to your Dedicated contract. Outline below is a proposed approach; I attached a first-pass addendum (redwood-dedicated-addendum-draft.pdf) for your procurement team's review.

Proposed sequencing:
1) Commercial amendment + PO (1 week) — Ben will generate updated pricing and a term change.
2) Capacity provisioning window (2–3 weeks) — engineering reserves the physical GPUs in target regions and validates kernel build for your models.
3) Onboarding & failover testing (1 week) — smoke tests, KV-cache warmup, and simulated cross-region failover.

SLA / throughput: we can guarantee a committed throughput per-region (tokens/sec) aligned with the reserved GPU count. We'll include a soft-burst policy (up to 1.5x for short windows) and a defined overage cadence if sustained burst occurs. For tail latency, we'll target p99 < 300ms for typical chat loads; we will share profiling data once we see your per-route prompt lengths and batch configs.

Next steps:
- Ben: draft amended quote and PO line items.
- Roadmap: coordinate provisioning dates after PO.
- Atlas: send the target traffic profile spreadsheet (appx traffic shape + prompt lengths).

I attached the addendum draft. Happy to jump on a short call to walk procurement through the changes.

Best,
Hannah

--
Hannah Schmitt
Enterprise Lead, North America — Redwood Inference
From: Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.com>
To: Marta Ruiz <marta.ruiz@atlaslabs.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 20 Aug 2026 11:28:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal planning — adding EU/APAC dedicated pools and throughput guarantees

Marta — quick engineering notes on the onboarding/testing side so expectations are aligned:

Provisioning checklist (EU / APAC):
- Confirm region-specific instance types (we will provision A100-equivalent mix and verify quantized runtime)
- Kernel and compilation pass for your model family (expect 48–72h for the first validation build)
- KV-cache seeding: recommend a 24–48h warmup window with synthetic traffic before routing live traffic
- Batching config: we will propose optimal continuous-batching parameters after we see your payload distribution

Failover behavior:
- Active-Active routing by default (split by geo rule). If a region degrades, traffic will fail over to the nearest healthy region with a downgrade plan to a smaller model variant to preserve latency/SLOs.
- We'll include a canary playbook and a test that simulates full-region loss during onboarding.

Latency note: achieving p99 < 300ms depends heavily on prompt length and the degree of batching tolerated by your app — we'll run two representative prompt sets you share and provide a latency/throughput matrix.

I'll coordinate with infra on the provisioning runway once procurement confirms the PO date.

— Soojin
From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: procurement@atlaslabs.com, Marta Ruiz <marta.ruiz@atlaslabs.com>
Cc: Hannah Schmitt <hannah@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 24 Aug 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal planning — adding EU/APAC dedicated pools and throughput guarantees

Hi Marta / Procurement team —

Attached is the commercial worksheet and the PO-ready amendment (redwood-dedicated-addendum-draft.pdf). Summary: 12-month term extension with incremental reserved capacity: +24 EU GPUs, +16 APAC GPUs. Monthly committed throughput and soft-burst terms are in the pricing sheet (atlas-capacity-requirements-aug2026.xlsx).

Key items for procurement:
- Please confirm billing entity and send PO referencing deal RDW-8723.
- We will issue a final DocuSign link after PO is received.
- Expect a 2–3 week provisioning window from signature.

Doc links: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/8723 | DocuSign will be generated once we receive PO.

Ben Carter
Account Executive — Redwood Inference
From: Marta Ruiz <marta.ruiz@atlaslabs.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@atlaslabs.com, Ethan Cho <ethan.cho@atlaslabs.com>
Date: Mon, 24 Aug 2026 15:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal planning — adding EU/APAC dedicated pools and throughput guarantees

Thanks — procurement has the worksheet and will route a PO by EOD Thursday. We also uploaded our traffic profile (see atlas-capacity-requirements-aug2026.xlsx). Two quick clarifications before we sign:

1) Failover latency: when traffic fails over from EU -> US, what is the expected p99 delta for short-chat workloads?
2) Overage billing: if we exceed the soft-burst allowance for more than 72 hours, how will that be invoiced?

If you can call out the answers to those in the DocuSign cover memo, procurement will be able to approve faster. Otherwise we should be able to get PO to you Thursday.

— Marta
